_comment: MiniMax Token Plan (subscription; opencode login `minimax-coding-plan`; quota adapter `minimax`). Merge the profiles you need into .lean-worker/profiles.json and replace the {build command} / {test command} placeholders. Each chain ends in Claude: it runs only when the operator gives the go on an `escalate:` line. Bash runs only the allowedTools patterns and every segment of a pipeline must match, so the common read-only helpers are pre-approved. Give code tasks --write-scope: these models have edited files outside the task's scope. Review a change with a model of another family than the one that wrote it (for example review-<other family>, or the base template's Claude review). Measured in sy11a_ctxops (2026-09-29): MiniMax-M3 chains shell commands (`|`, `;`, `,`) and needs these helpers; one 270-test code task took 241 calls at $1.27 list-price equivalent and moved the 5h window by 4%. Runtime is claude (the plan's Anthropic-compatible endpoint), so an escalation to Claude stays in the same runtime; "runtime": "opencode" also works and starts with a smaller context.
